reason: Prior P01 resolution had zero source/evidence references despite claiming CRS, geometry, feature, raster/grid, network, trajectory, terrain and point-cloud distinctions.
bounded_resolution: Retain geospatial project/workflow/result-publication lifecycle only as an operated composition layer. Import native authorities for CRS, geometry/feature, raster/grid, moving-feature/trajectory and point-cloud representation. Do not let storage encodings or analytical methods acquire phenomenon, decision or publication authority.
noncollapse_laws: point cloud != classified object != inspection finding
invalidation_condition: Reopen on material OGC/ISO edition changes or a counterexample showing an unrepresented geospatial semantic class.

reason: Living protocol/runtime evidence required edition refresh after the prior convergence packet.
bounded_resolution: Keep model/agent extensions as optional replaceable capability/runtime ports. MCP's stateless core and extension/task model and WASI component features strengthen the need to represent protocol/runtime capabilities explicitly rather than infer enterprise state or authority from sessions, tools or component interfaces.
invalidation_condition: Reopen on breaking protocol/runtime editions that change capability, state, task, resource or authority assumptions.

reason: WASI 0.3.1 adopted Component Model features after the generic prior WASI03 evidence label and must be edition-pinned.
bounded_resolution: Preserve separation among abstract resource request, reservation, limit/quota, lease, scheduling, observed usage, pressure/eviction and cost. WASI component/runtime features are capability evidence only and do not own resource-policy or provider-binding decisions.
invalidation_condition: Reopen when runtime/resource standards materially change resource identity, isolation, cancellation or accounting semantics.

reason: One Arrow citation cannot substantiate native authority boundaries for 33 heterogeneous shapes spanning healthcare, scientific arrays, genomics, mail/calendar, financial messages, engineering/3D, geospatial catalogs and protected envelopes.
required_research: derive native authority map per shape class
recheck P03/P04/P05 projections for every affected member
invalidation_condition: Close only after every represented shape class has a native authority or an explicit evidence-backed no-standard ruling.

reason: MIPLIB is authoritative evidence for mixed-integer programming benchmarks, not for the full 21-library family spanning optimization, constraint solving, simulation, heuristics and related decision-problem semantics.
required_research: separate mathematical problem authority by formalism
define certificate and infeasibility authority by method class
recheck solver capability versus governed action proposal boundary
invalidation_condition: Close after formalism-complete evidence coverage and member-level counterexample sweep.

reason: A proper-scoring-rule source supports probabilistic forecast evaluation but does not by itself establish edition, selection, override and publication lifecycle authority.
required_research: research forecast identity/vintage/issue/reference-time standards and mature practice
test forecast vs scenario vs plan vs commitment across unrelated verticals
invalidation_condition: Close when lifecycle semantics are independently evidenced beyond evaluation theory.

reason: FOCUS 1.4 and TMF620 cover billing/cost usage and product catalog portions, but not the claimed support case, incident/status, maintenance, payment/refund and supplier-exit lifecycle universe.
required_research: add independent primary authority for support/incident/status
prove portfolio-family composition without mega-aggregate collapse
invalidation_condition: Close only when every claimed operated lifecycle class has evidence or is removed/re-homed.

reason: QUDT, SPIFFE and OAuth evidence only a small subset of the 60-library claimed universal semantic foundation. Universality requires stronger proof than package reuse.
required_research: classify each of 60 members as truly universal primitive, imported bounded semantic, or misplaced convenience
require at least two unrelated-domain witnesses for universal primitives
rehome business calendars, evidence authority, identity policy and other bounded meanings
rerun symbol ownership and exact-contract collision analysis
invalidation_condition: Close only when no member remains universal solely because it is widely reused.
